test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.**

I fell asleep __after I am reading__ a novel.
solution: The correct answer is** 'while I was reading'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here,** 'while I was reading' **should be used instead of **'after I am reading'.** • We use '**while**' to show that actions or events happen at the same time in the **past, present, or future**. • *Example: They were talking **while** the teacher **was explaining** the activity.* • **'was reading' **should be used instead of** 'am reading' **because the given sentence is in the past tense already. **Correct Sentence:__** *I fell asleep **while I was reading** a novel.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ **'while I was reading' **का प्रयोग **'after I am reading' **के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए। • हम '**while**' का उपयोग यह दिखाने के लिए करते हैं कि कार्य या घटनाएँ एक ही समय में भूत, वर्तमान या भविष्य में घटित होती हैं। • *Example: They were talking **while** the teacher **was explaining **the activity.* • **'am reading'** के बजाय **'was reading' **का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए क्योंकि दिया गया वाक्य पहले से ही **past tense** में है। d1:T135c, The correct answer is **'Bill said that he had missed his train and that he would be late for work.'**
